messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: repeated CUDA allocation failures and container exits during model warmup in eu-central-1. Affected pool: inf-gpu-rt-3 (12 nodes), ~4 nodes flapped, autoscaler started churn. Paging oncall.

oncall-sre: I'm on call. seeing burst of `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` from runtime warmup thread. Crash loop on pod warmup worker. Collecting logs and nvcrash dumps. Please avoid mass restarts until we have a safer eviction plan.

alex.runtime: quick context: this model does per-shard ahead-of-time compilation on first request which allocates workspace buffers. If compile fails it retries with different kernels and can request additional scratch. Could be runaway on certain artifact shapes.

sara.ml: which model sha? any artifact fetch errors or truncated downloads reported by artifact-service?

oncall-sre: artifact-service shows intermittent `etag mismatch` for model sha: a1b2c3d4. Several nodes logged `verify_manifest: checksum mismatch, retrying` within the same 10s window prior to deserialize.

ben.ops: customers: two upgrades hitting eu-central-1 caused spike in warmups; CS report coming in. I'm going to temporarily disable concurrency-based warmups and set cold-instance limit to 1. Will also put affected ASG into manual scaling.

cs-rep: Customer A reports ~8% increased 5xx on chat endpoints since 08:04 UTC, they escalated to SEV3. Providing a brief note to them now: "We're investigating runtime warmup crashes in eu-central-1; some requests may fail or be slower. We'll update in 20 minutes." :mailbox_with_mail:

alex.runtime: mitigation plan: 1) disable ahead-of-time compile for this model (flip runtime flag), 2) force fallback to interpreted kernels on warmup, 3) evict nodes with >3 warmup failures in 5m. Deployable change exists as `runtime-toggle/no-atoc-guard`.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Starting canary rollout of runtime-toggle/no-atoc-guard to eu-central-1-canary (3 pods). Canary health checks running.

deploy-bot: Canary 3/3 healthy. No new OOMs observed on canary for 10m. Proceeding region-wide toggle push.

policy-bot: Note: disabling ATOC will increase CPU usage and may increase latency slightly. Autoscaler override applied to keep min nodes +2 for the region.

oncall-sre: region toggle applied. Now throttling artifact server to 10 concurrent downloads to reduce partial fetches. Also set `RUNTIME_WARMUP_RETRIES=1` to avoid repeated heavy retries.

sara.ml: root cause hypothesis: transient artifact corruption/partial fetch -> deserialize attempted on partial blob -> runtime invoked fallback compile which escalated memory usage -> CUDA OOM + container crash -> autoscaler reacted causing more nodes to warm up and repeat the issue (stampede). We should debatch artifact downloads and validate streaming checksums before deserialize.

ben.ops: nodes with disk I/O errors found on two hosts; evicted and reprovisioned. Hooking in infra team to check storage network path to artifact store.

cs-rep: Sent customer update: "We have applied a temporary mitigation and rerouted traffic where needed. We're monitoring and expect a more detailed update in 45 minutes. Apologies for the disruption." Customer A acknowledged.

oncall-sre: Monitoring: cuda.oom.count dropping to zero after toggle, artifact-retry rate reduced by 85%. Marking incident as mitigated for now. Will remain in watch for 1 hour.

alex.runtime: follow-ups: ticket to implement stream-validated deserialization (fail fast on checksum), add a compile memory cap and an emergency fallback to smaller kernel, and add a warmup-safety circuit that aborts after 1 heavy-compile attempt. I'll file PRs.

sara.ml: also adding a regression test harness to simulate partial artifact fetch + compile fallback to ensure we don't regress.

ben.ops: leaving handoff notes: watch `cuda.oom.count`, `warmup.failure_rate`, and `artifact.etag_mismatch`. If `warmup.failure_rate` > 1% for 10m, escalate to SEV2 and re-enable canary traffic diversion.

oncall-sre: Handoff: I'll be handing to next oncall in 30m. Current status: mitigation applied, customers notified, infra investigating storage path. Tags: warmup, cuda-oom, artifact-checksum. Postmortem required.
